claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA total, consisting of 525,000 ADA for Oura maintenance and enhancement plus a 15,750 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.

The stated maintenance funding covers a part-time Oura maintainer for 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD, with 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve referenced in the motivation section.
Oura is described as a Rust-native Cardano event pipeline tool that connects to Cardano nodes, monitors blockchain events, and routes matching patterns to pluggable outputs.

The proposal states that Oura supports multiple data sources including N2C, N2N, S3, Mithril, and UTxO RPC, and sinks including Kafka, Elasticsearch, AWS Lambda/S3/SQS, RabbitMQ, Redis, SQL databases, and webhooks.
The proposal states that Oura has 654 commits, 288 stars, 79 forks, and 58 contributors, and provides the Oura GitHub repository as a checkable source.
The proposal states that Oura was previously funded through Project Catalyst Funds 9 and 13 for feature development.
The proposal states that TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development on schedule.
The proposal states that the withdrawal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and references voting and audited-results materials.
The proposal states that the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at submission time.

The proposal states that Intersect will administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, multisig-style authorization thresholds, oversight entities, milestone-based disbursement controls, and a public dashboard.

summary: The anchor asks for 540,750 ADA to fund 12 months of Oura maintenance and administration through Intersect-managed treasury smart contracts, with claims about Oura's technical utility, open-source adoption, prior TxPipe delivery, Intersect budget approval, NCL compliance, and oversight controls.
